description: While logging, the active card shows only a name and a target. Nothing says what the movement looks like. Add a tap-to-play movement preview on the active exercise card. Not instruction, not form coaching — a reminder of the shape of the lift. SOURCE (verified live 2026-09-12): bryllim/workout-guide. 302 exercises x 3 SVG frames at packages/workout-guide/assets//frame-{1,2,3}.svg. Code MIT; artwork CC BY-SA 4.0 derived from Everkinetic (also CC BY-SA 4.0) — clean provenance, unlike free-exercise-db whose Unlicense covers the JSON only and whose photos are scraped. Each frame is a single in a 512x512 viewBox, ~15 KB. Frames 1/2/3 are real phases (top/mid/bottom) so 1->2->3->2 is a genuine animation. Rejected: ExerciseDB and MuscleWiki are hot-link only and their URLs demonstrably rot (old ExerciseDB CDN is dead, current endpoint is keyed). wger covers 32%, with 202 of 273 having a single image. Generating our own is 65-200h by hand or $130-400 of AI video with anatomy errors needing human review. COVERAGE (measured against the 65-entry EXERCISE_CATALOG): 54/65 on exact normalized name. Ten of the eleven misses have an unambiguous override, giving 64/65: Barbell Bench Press -> bench-press Back Squat -> squat Barbell Curl -> bicep-curl Face Pulls -> face-pull Triceps Pushdown -> tricep-pushdown Overhead Triceps Extension -> overhead-tricep-extension Skullcrusher -> single-dumbbell-skullcrusher Single-Arm Dumbbell Row -> dumbbell-bent-over-row Seated Hamstring Curl -> seated-leg-curl Nordic Curl -> nordic-hamstring-curl "Machine Triceps Extension" has no asset and renders nothing. Verify every override by eye against the rendered SVG before committing; a wrong demo is worse than none. DECIDED: play on tap, not on loop (the logging screen stays calm). Session card ONLY — not the swap list, library, or program builder. No artwork means render nothing: no placeholder, no gap, layout collapses. Mirrors findCatalogExercise's exact-match-never-fuzzy rule. APPROACH — no schema, API, or shared-contract change. TodayExercise already carries `name`; slug resolution is a pure web-side function (an asset lookup, not a request/response shape, so it does not belong in @afya/shared). No server change either. apps/api/src/index.ts:77-82 serves only /assets/* from web-dist plus an SPA fallback, so apps/web/public/ would NOT be served in production. Put SVGs under apps/web/src/assets/exercise-art//frame-N.svg and resolve with a lazy URL glob: import.meta.glob("../assets/exercise-art/*/frame-*.svg", { query: "?url", import: "default" }) Vite emits each into dist/assets/ content-hashed, which production already serves. THEMING — CSS mask, not . The frames are single-path silhouettes, so: mask-image: var(--frame); mask-size: contain; background: var(--text-soft). This satisfies CLAUDE.md's "colour is addressed by role, never by hue" (the figure follows the palette like the charts do), and because the file is referenced byte-for-byte and never recoloured we distribute rather than adapt — CC BY-SA share-alike never reaches our own code. FILES — new: scripts/fetch-exercise-art.ts — one-shot vendoring script. Reads EXERCISE_CATALOG, applies the override table, fetches 64 x 3 frames from raw.githubusercontent.com, fails loudly on a 404 rather than writing a partial set. Committed for reproducibility; assets committed too (~3.8 MB raw, ~1.4 MB gzipped, ~22 KB per exercise lazy). apps/web/src/lib/exercise-art.ts — exerciseArtSlug(name): string | null. Normalize (lowercase, non-alphanumeric -> "-"), look up the generated slug set, then the override table, else null. Never fuzzy. apps/web/src/components/ExerciseDemo.tsx — holds `playing` state, lazy-loads the three frame URLs on first play, cross-fades 1->2->3->2 on a ~2.4s CSS loop, stops after a few cycles or on second tap. Returns null when the slug is null. A
title: Exercise demo artwork on the session card
